name: guess-the-eleven
description: GUESS THE ELEVEN - Real-time 11-player drawing and guessing party game

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=backend && npm run build --workspace=frontend
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=backend && npm run test --workspace=frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=backend && npm run lint --workspace=frontend
scripts.render:build: npm run db:generate && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed && npm run build --workspace=frontend && npm run build --workspace=backend

author: Guess The Eleven Team
